name: Saddler
description:
You're experienced riding the beasts of the plains of Kerok.

All your rolls against animals are favored. Whenever you roll Lore to recall information about animals, +2d.

Once per rest, you may spend an action to roll Craft vs Strength against an adjacent animal at least 2 sizes larger than you. If you or your allies have harmed the animal within the past day, your roll is ill-favored and the animal’s roll is favored. On a win, it becomes willing to bear you for the next day. On a loss, the animal runs away or, if it cannot run away, it becomes hostile to you and your allies.

Describe your way with animals.
successes:
✨: The animal will bear you for one additional day.

🌞: The animal will bear you for as long as you choose.

💀: The animal becomes hostile and immediately makes an attack against you.
